title: Token Econ Efficiency Audit Q1
summary: Quarterly spreadsheet audit focused on per-token economics for hosted API across regions and model families. This sheet consolidates observed runtime telemetry with amortized infra costs, explores short-term savings by slot/tiling adjustments, and quantifies margin delta under three sensitivity scenarios (baseline, aggressive quant, high-utilization). Goal: produce a prioritized set of low-friction optimizations for H2 rollout and an ops checklist for safe canarying.
assumptions: GPU hour pricing is based on spot and on-demand blended rates per region as of 2024-10
Average request mix uses family-level seq_len distribution sampled from last 90 days
KV cache hit rates are variable by customer segment; baseline = 18% global hit
Batching latency SLO is 120ms p95 for premium tier; anything requiring >200ms is routed to cheaper fallback model
License/third-party model fees are amortized per-token where applicable
key_tables_snapshot: Tabs: summary, raw-telemetry, amortization, regional-ppk, sensitivity-scenarios, action-prioritization. regional-ppk columns: region, model_family, avg_seq_len, tokens_per_call, p95_latency_ms, slot_util_pct, gpu_type, gpu_hour_cost_usd, throughput_tokens_per_hour, amortized_cogs_per_token_usd, target_price_per_token_usd, gross_margin_pct
calc_methods: COGS per token = (gpu_hour_cost_usd / throughput_tokens_per_hour) + infra_overhead_per_token + average_network_egress_per_token + amortized_license_per_token - cache_savings_per_token. Throughput_tokens_per_hour derived from bench samples adjusted for batching efficiency (effective_batch_size * tokens_per_request * requests_per_sec * 3600). Sensitivity scenarios tweak: cache_hit_rate, effective_batch_size, quantization_savings_pct, spot_blend_fraction.
high_level_findings: Regional variation: US-west shows best raw ppk due to cheaper spot inventory but higher egress; APAC margins shrink ~12-18% under current pricing mix
Model family impact: LlamaX-70B has ~2.6x token COGS vs LlamaX-13B at median seq_len; routing candidate window exists for conversational tail where 13B provides acceptable quality
Cache leverage: increasing KV cache hit from 18% to 35% yields ~6-9% absolute margin improvement for chat-heavy workloads; websocket session affinity changes required
Slot tiling: collapsing 4 small slots into 1 medium slot reduces idle leakage by ~7% for mid-utilization cohorts but increases p95 latency for bursty clients — tradeoff needs canarying
Quantization: aggressive int4 path shows up to 28% per-token savings on LlamaX-70B in lab; production guardrails needed (eval set + regeneration checks) before broad rollout
action_items: Run canary of slot-tiling change with low-latency enterprise customers (owned by Noah) in us-west for 2 weeks
Add KV cache hit-rate dashboard breakouts by customer cohort and route (Priya to own metric tagging)
Prototype automatic quality guard (eval prompt set) for int4 candidates and place behind feature flag (Diego + infra)
Update pricing decision doc with regional ppk deltas and recommend temporary surcharge in APAC until egress optimization completes
Ship a lightweight routing rule that routes seq_len < 120 to 13B for non-image assistant category and measure regen quality

amortization: gpu_hour assumptions, infra overhead lines (storage, egress, control plane), license amortization

notes: This is an iterative audit intended to land quick wins ahead of the H2 cost program. Not every hypothesis needs immediate product change; some are ops playbooks. Please annotate the sensitivity tab with any additional regional cost inputs you have (GCP vs AWS vs Azure SKU links).
review_checks: Required before canary: 1) formal regen-qa pass on eval buckets, 2) SLO smoke tests for affected routes, 3) billing simulation for impacted customers
expected_next_steps: Combine findings with dedicated capacity forecasts and present prioritized proposals in Optimize guild on 2024-12-09. If approved, schedule two-week canaries and instrument additional tracing for kv-cache hits.
